title: きっちんのおと (Kitchin no Oto)
description: A child watches their parent cook dinner and discovers the kitchen is full of sounds. Vegetables are chopped (とんとん), onions sizzle (じゅうじゅう), soup bubbles (ぐつぐつ), the microwave pings (チン！), and the whole family eats together with happy sounds (もぐもぐ、ごくごく). A warm, cozy, domestic story rich with cooking onomatopoeia.
author: オリジナル
